parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query instance IDs.

> N specifies the sequence number of the instance ID. For example, ResourceId.0 specifies the first instance ID, and ResourceId.1 specifies the second instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags (key-value pairs) to bind.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag.
> - N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.0.Key specifies the key of the first tag, and Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the second tag.
- Empty strings are not allowed.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag.
> - N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.0.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the second tag.
- Empty strings are allowed.
